metadata.description: Nerdway open-source Claude Code skills for daily developer workflows.

plugins.name: nerdway
plugins.description: Daily developer workflow automation — bootstrap new projects with git, GitHub, Linear, and spec-creating skills; write well-specified Linear issues; drive Linear issues through a status-driven plan-implement-review workflow; mechanically close out an issue (commit, push, merge PR/MR on GitHub or GitLab, set Done); resume a project from its last checkpoint on the nerdbrain entity page, verified against git and Linear; bootstrap the CLIs those skills require.
